> [!NOTE] > ## Reviews paused > > It looks like this branch is under active development. To avoid overwhelming you with review comments due to an influx of new commits, CodeRabbit has automatically paused this review. You can configure this behavior by changing the `reviews.auto_review.auto_pause_after_reviewed_commits` setting. > > Use the following commands to manage reviews: > - `@coderabbitai resume` to resume automatic reviews. > - `@coderabbitai review` to trigger a single review. > > Use the checkboxes below for quick actions: > - [ ] ▶️ Resume reviews > - [ ] 🔍 Trigger review ## Walkthrough Adds a serial e2e suite that creates SELinux-labeled pods on a shared RWO PVC, checks upgrade readiness conditions, and polls Thanos and Prometheus signals across conflicting, compatible, and remediation scenarios. ### Changes **SELinux mount readiness** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Suite and storage setup**
`test/e2e/selinux_mount_readiness.go`|Defines readiness constants, gates execution on SELinux-mount-capable default storage, and provisions isolated namespaces with RWO PVCs.| |**SELinux pod lifecycle**
`test/e2e/selinux_mount_readiness.go`|Creates shared-PVC pause pods with SELinux options and provides lifecycle and diagnostic helpers.| |**Readiness and monitoring**
`test/e2e/selinux_mount_readiness.go`|Polls ClusterOperator and Storage CR conditions and queries Thanos metrics and Prometheus alert state.| |**Conflict and remediation scenarios**
`test/e2e/selinux_mount_readiness.go`|Tests conflicting and compatible labels, compatible pod recreation, and recursive change policy remediation.| **Estimated code review effort:** 4 (Complex) | ~45 minutes ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Test participant KubernetesAPI participant StorageOperator participant ThanosQuerier Test->>KubernetesAPI: create SELinux-labeled shared-RWO pods KubernetesAPI->>StorageOperator: report workload readiness Test->>StorageOperator: poll Upgradeable condition Test->>ThanosQuerier: query conflict metric and alert state Test->>KubernetesAPI: delete or recreate pods Test->>StorageOperator: poll recovery to Upgradeable=True ``` **Suggested reviewers:** `mpatlasov`, `stephenfin` --- > [!IMPORTANT] > ## Pre-merge checks failed > > Please resolve all errors before merging. Addressing warnings is optional. ### ❌ Failed checks (1 error, 3 warnings) | Check name | Status | Explanation | Resolution | | :----------------------------------------------: | :--------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | No-Sensitive-Data-In-Logs | ❌ Error | Logs print pod node names in Ginkgo output and structured logs, which can expose internal hostnames. | Remove or redact node identifiers from By/GinkgoLogr messages; keep only non-sensitive pod/label info or hash the node. | | Docstring Coverage | ⚠️ Warning | Docstring coverage is 0.00% which is insufficient. The required threshold is 80.00%. | Write docstrings for the functions missing them to satisfy the coverage threshold. | | Test Structure And Quality | ⚠️ Warning | The test uses nine bare g.Fail(err.Error()) calls, so several failures lack scenario-specific diagnostic context. | Wrap failures with contextual messages (e.g. which pod/condition failed) and prefer ctx-aware Ginkgo blocks where practical. | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ⚠️ Warning | The suite is marked [Skipped:Disconnected] and uses the public k8s.gcr.io/pause:3.2 image, so it still depends on external registry connectivity. | Use an internal/mirrored pause image or a release/image-stream ref so the test can run in disconnected CI. |
✅ Passed checks (11 passed) | Check name | Status | Explanation | | :--------------------------------------------: | :------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | | Description Check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped - CodeRabbit’s high-level summary is enabled. | | Title check | ✅ Passed | The title clearly summarizes the main change: adding an e2e test for SELinuxMount upgrade readiness. | | Linked Issues check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Out of Scope Changes check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Stable And Deterministic Test Names | ✅ Passed | All Ginkgo titles in the new test file are static string literals; no generated names, timestamps, or other dynamic values appear. | | Microshift Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | The new Ginkgo Describe is tagged [Skipped:MicroShift], so its use of storage/monitoring/ClusterOperator APIs is exempt from MicroShift compatibility checks. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | Test only pins both pods to the same node and shows no multi-node, anti-affinity, or rescheduling assumptions; no SNO skip guard is needed. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | Test-only change; no node selectors, affinities, spread constraints, or control-plane/worker assumptions were added. | | Ote Binary Stdout Contract | ✅ Passed | PASS: The new test file has no fmt.Print/Println/Printf, klog/log stdout setup, or init/TestMain/RunSpecs; logging is via GinkgoLogr in test helpers. | | No-Weak-Crypto | ✅ Passed | The new test file contains no MD5/SHA1/DES/RC4/3DES/Blowfish/ECB or custom crypto; searches found no crypto imports or weak-comparison patterns. | | Container-Privileges | ✅ Passed | The new pod spec is non-root, drops all capabilities, and sets allowPrivilegeEscalation=false;
